minutes.summary: A short meeting: the committee approved the July 30 minutes by roll call, noted a new Parks member, and talked about scheduling and officer rotation. Most of the discussion was a report that Town Counsel says notice timing for removing land from Chapter 61 is set by statute, and ideas for a town-side checklist for applicants. The meeting adjourned by roll call.

what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee heard a report that Town Counsel says notice timing for removing land from Chapter 61 is set by statute; no action was taken.
Committee members discussed adding a Chapter 61 enrollment check or applicant checklist to conservation and planning applications; Mary will follow up with staff.
The July 30 minutes were approved by roll call.
Open space plan update outreach, including public notices such as in water bills, was tabled, and officer rotation will be discussed at the November or December meeting.
The chair will be absent on October 9, and the meeting may be cancelled if quorum is doubtful or nothing urgent arises.

why_it_matters: Chapter 61 land is enrolled at reduced tax assessment in exchange for the town's right of first refusal when it is sold or converted, so a checklist in permit applications would affect whether the town learns of such land in time to act.
The open space plan update and its public outreach were tabled, so no resident notice or survey has been scheduled yet.
